items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Item timeline without chart dependencies: TimelineGraph (HTML items over an SVG grid; two-tier time axis, lanes with sub-lane stacking, bars and milestones, status shapes, dependency connectors, live now line, continuous zoom with ladder/fit, pan, keyboard navigation, readout strip, collapsible lane groups, real table view with sorting) and a vertical Timeline event list with dot-glyph markers. timeline-layout exports the pure time/px geometry.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Migration v3 -> v4: scale/onScaleChange -> zoom/defaultZoom/onZoomChange (week density 128 px/week -> 168 px/week); items are HTML buttons (selectors on svg [data-item-id] / [data-part=shape] change; SVG is decorative, [data-part=grid]); the lane-label column is outside the scroller; Up/Down change lane; now omitted = live clock; items/defaultItems props. TimelineGraph needs a label; dates accept Date, ISO string or epoch ms; locale defaults to ko-KR.
